passages.text: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
passages.sermon:
The city is full of oppressors.
The city is rebellious.
The city is defiled.
Woe to this city.
passages.original: ה֥וֹי מֹרְאָ֖ה וְנִגְאָלָ֑ה הָעִ֖יר הַיּוֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.
passages.sermon:
This city is rebellious and defiled.
She does not listen to any voice.
She does not accept correction.
She does not trust in the LORD.
She does not come close to her God.
passages.original: לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעָה֙ בְּק֔וֹל לֹ֥א לָקְחָ֖ה מוּסָ֑ר בַּֽיהוָה֙ לֹ֣א בָטָ֔חָה אֶל־ אֱלֹהֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א קָרֵֽבָה׃

passages.text: Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.
passages.sermon:
The city is rebellious and defiled.
Her princes live in the city.
Her princes act like roaring lions.
Her judges live in the city.
Her judges act like evening wolves.
The judges leave nothing for the morning.
passages.original: שָׂרֶ֣יהָ בְקִרְבָּ֔הּ אֲרָי֖וֹת שֹֽׁאֲגִ֑ים שֹׁפְטֶ֙יהָ֙ זְאֵ֣בֵי עֶ֔רֶב לֹ֥א גָרְמ֖וּ לַבֹּֽקֶר׃

passages.text: Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.
passages.sermon:
The prophets in this city act recklessly.
These prophets do not keep faith.
The priests in this city treat the holy place as common.
These priests harm and break the law.
passages.original: נְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ פֹּֽחֲזִ֔ים אַנְשֵׁ֖י בֹּֽגְד֑וֹת כֹּהֲנֶ֙יהָ֙ חִלְּלוּ־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ חָמְס֖וּ תּוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is present within the city.
The LORD is righteous.
The LORD does no wrong.
The LORD gives justice every morning.
The LORD brings His justice to light at dawn.
The LORD never fails to do this.
The unjust do not know shame.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה צַדִּיק֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַוְלָ֑ה בַּבֹּ֨קֶר בַּבֹּ֜קֶר מִשְׁפָּט֨וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן לָאוֹר֙ לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔ר וְלֹֽא־ יוֹדֵ֥עַ עַוָּ֖ל בֹּֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: “I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority and power.
The LORD says, "I have cut off the nations."
I destroyed their strong towers.
I made their streets empty.
No one walks there now.
Their cities are ruined.
No person lives there.
No one remains in those places.
passages.original: הִכְרַ֣תִּי גוֹיִ֗ם נָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ פִּנּוֹתָ֔ם הֶחֱרַ֥בְתִּי חֽוּצוֹתָ֖ם מִבְּלִ֣י עוֹבֵ֑ר נִצְדּ֧וּ עָרֵיהֶ֛ם מִבְּלִי־ אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃

passages.text: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to His people.
God expected them to fear Him.
God wanted them to accept His correction.
If they listened, God would not destroy their home.
God had already punished them for their wrong actions.
But the people did not change.
They got up early each day.
They continued to do evil in everything they did.
passages.original: אָמַ֜רְתִּי אַךְ־ תִּירְאִ֤י אוֹתִי֙ תִּקְחִ֣י מוּסָ֔ר וְלֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֣ת מְעוֹנָ֔הּ כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ פָּקַ֖דְתִּי עָלֶ֑יהָ אָכֵן֙ הִשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ הִשְׁחִ֔יתוּ כֹּ֖ל עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation— all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD commands the people to wait for Him.
The LORD says, "Wait for Me until the day I rise to testify."
The LORD has made a decision.
The LORD will gather the nations.
The LORD will assemble the kingdoms.
The LORD will pour out His indignation on them.
The LORD will show all His burning anger.
The LORD says all the earth will be consumed.
The fire of the LORD's jealousy will consume the whole earth.
passages.original: לָכֵ֤ן חַכּוּ־ לִי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה לְי֖וֹם קוּמִ֣י לְעַ֑ד כִּ֣י מִשְׁפָּטִי֩ לֶאֱסֹ֨ף גּוֹיִ֜ם לְקָבְצִ֣י מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לִשְׁפֹּ֨ךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם זַעְמִי֙ כֹּ֚ל חֲר֣וֹן אַפִּ֔י כִּ֚י בְּאֵ֣שׁ קִנְאָתִ֔י תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the nations.
God promises to act in the future.
God will give the peoples pure speech.
All people will call on the name of the LORD.
All people will serve the LORD together.
They will serve Him with unity.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֛ז אֶהְפֹּ֥ךְ אֶל־ עַמִּ֖ים שָׂפָ֣ה בְרוּרָ֑ה לִקְרֹ֤א כֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לְעָבְד֖וֹ שְׁכֶ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God has worshipers.
God’s worshipers are His scattered people.
Some of God’s worshipers live far away.
They live beyond the rivers of Cush.
These worshipers will bring an offering to God.
passages.original: מֵעֵ֖בֶר לְנַֽהֲרֵי־ כ֑וּשׁ עֲתָרַי֙ בַּת־ פוּצַ֔י יוֹבִל֖וּן מִנְחָתִֽי׃

passages.text: On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises a future day.
On that day, you will not feel shame.
You will not be ashamed of your past deeds.
You will not be ashamed of the ways you sinned against God.
God will act for you.
God will remove proud people from among you.
These people rejoice in their pride.
God will take them away from your midst.
You will not be proud again on God’s holy mountain.
You will not lift yourself up in arrogance there ever again.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא לֹ֤א תֵב֙וֹשִׁי֙ מִכֹּ֣ל עֲלִילֹתַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּשַׁ֖עַתְּ בִּ֑י כִּי־ אָ֣ז׀ אָסִ֣יר מִקִּרְבֵּ֗ךְ עַלִּיזֵי֙ גַּאֲוָתֵ֔ךְ וְלֹֽא־ תוֹסִ֧פִי לְגָבְהָ֛ה ע֖וֹד בְּהַ֥ר קָדְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God says He will leave a group among them.
This group will be meek.
This group will be humble.
These people will trust in the name of the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּ֣י בְקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י וָדָ֑ל וְחָס֖וּ בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.”
passages.sermon:
The remnant of Israel will remain.
They will not do wrong.
They will not speak lies.
No one will find a deceitful tongue in their mouths.
They will feed in safety.
They will lie down in peace.
No one will make them afraid.
passages.original: שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא־ יַעֲשׂ֤וּ עַוְלָה֙ וְלֹא־ יְדַבְּר֣וּ כָזָ֔ב וְלֹֽא־ יִמָּצֵ֥א בְּפִיהֶ֖ם לְשׁ֣וֹן תַּרְמִ֑ית כִּֽי־ הֵ֛מָּה יִרְע֥וּ וְרָבְצ֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃ס

passages.text: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
passages.sermon:
The people of Zion are God's chosen people.
God calls the people of Zion to sing for joy.
God calls Israel to shout aloud.
God tells the people of Jerusalem to be glad.
God tells the people of Jerusalem to rejoice with all their heart.
passages.original: רָנִּי֙ בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֖יעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שִׂמְחִ֤י וְעָלְזִי֙ בְּכָל־ לֵ֔ב בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is Israel’s King.
The LORD is with you.
The LORD has taken away your punishment.
The LORD has turned back your enemy.
You will not fear harm anymore.
passages.original: הֵסִ֤יר יְהוָה֙ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔יִךְ פִּנָּ֖ה אֹֽיְבֵ֑ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל׀ יְהוָה֙ בְּקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ לֹא־ תִֽירְאִ֥י רָ֖ע עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jerusalem.
God calls Jerusalem by the name Zion.
God gives a message for a special day.
God says, “Do not be afraid, Zion.”
God says, “Do not let your hands grow weak.”
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יֵאָמֵ֥ר לִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אַל־ תִּירָ֑אִי צִיּ֖וֹן אַל־ יִרְפּ֥וּ יָדָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is among you.
The LORD is mighty.
The LORD saves you.
The LORD rejoices over you with gladness.
The LORD quiets you with His love.
The LORD rejoices over you with singing.
passages.original: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ך גִּבּ֣וֹר יוֹשִׁ֑יעַ יָשִׂ֨ישׂ עָלַ֜יִךְ בְּשִׂמְחָ֗ה יַחֲרִישׁ֙ בְּאַ֣הֲבָת֔וֹ יָגִ֥יל עָלַ֖יִךְ בְּרִנָּֽה׃

passages.text: “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people in Jerusalem.
God sees some people among you.
These people feel sorrow.
They grieve because they miss the appointed feasts.
God will gather these grieving people to Himself.
You will not suffer shame anymore.
God will remove your reproach.
passages.original: נוּגֵ֧י מִמּוֹעֵ֛ד אָסַ֖פְתִּי מִמֵּ֣ךְ הָי֑וּ מַשְׂאֵ֥ת עָלֶ֖יהָ חֶרְפָּֽה׃

passages.text: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He is present among you.
He is mighty to save.
At that time, I will act against all who afflict you.
I will save those who are lame.
I will gather those who are scattered.
I will give praise and fame to those who were disgraced.
I will do this throughout the whole earth.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה אֶת־ כָּל־ מְעַנַּ֖יִךְ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת־ הַצֹּלֵעָ֗ה וְהַנִּדָּחָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ וְשַׂמְתִּים֙ לִתְהִלָּ֣ה וּלְשֵׁ֔ם בְּכָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃

passages.text: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
The LORD promises to act at a specific time.
At that time, the LORD will bring His people back.
At that time, the LORD will gather His people together.
The LORD will give His people a good name.
The LORD will give His people praise among all the peoples of the earth.
The LORD will restore His people from captivity.
The LORD will do this where everyone can see it.
The LORD Himself has said these things.
passages.original: בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ אָבִ֣יא אֶתְכֶ֔ם וּבָעֵ֖ת קַבְּצִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְכֶ֜ם לְשֵׁ֣ם וְלִתְהִלָּ֗ה בְּכֹל֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשׁוּבִ֧י אֶת־ שְׁבוּתֵיכֶ֛ם לְעֵינֵיכֶ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
